answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a refundable stake that decays over a rolling horizon: a newcomer earns trust only through work attested by peers, and proven fraud slashes the stake. A lone identity is like an island - its reputation cannot be imported or copied, and even a flawless sonnet of fake history cannot substitute for attested deeds. Spinning up thousands of fake agents then costs thousands of stakes, while honest agents keep theirs.
